:::passage[Teks Bacaan (Soal No. 1 – 5)]
*The following text is for question number 1 to 5.*

My name is Raihan. I am 10 years old, and I am now in 5th grade of elementary school. I am the oldest student in my class. I have a younger brother named Fajar. He is small.
He is still 3 years old, he has chubby cheeks and curly hair. He will be having his fourth birthday next week, on August 9th.
:::

How is Raihan in his class?
explanation:
Teks: *"I am the oldest student in my class."* Raihan adalah siswa tertua di kelasnya.

Kunci Jawaban: **D (He is the oldest student in his class.)**

options.label: A

options.content: He is the smallest student in his class.

options.label: C

options.content: He is the oldest student in his class.

content:
Dimas : Do you like durian?
Wulan : No, I don't like … food.
explanation:
Durian terkenal dengan baunya yang menyengat, jadi Wulan tidak suka makanan yang berbau (*smelly*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Smelly)**

content: I love lime because it tastes ….
explanation:
Jeruk nipis (*lime*) rasanya asam (*sour*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Sour)**

content: Below is the food that tastes salty, except ….
explanation:
Keripik, kerupuk, dan telur asin rasanya asin. Cokelat (*chocolate*) rasanya manis, jadi itu jawabannya.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Chocolate)**

content: Rina is holding a red candy wrapped in plastic. What does Rina hold?
explanation:
Rina memegang permen merah, dan permen rasanya manis (*sweet candy*).

Kunci Jawaban: **D (Sweet candy)**

content: Which of these statements is right about the taste of the food?
explanation:
Jus jeruk bisa terasa sangat asam, jadi pernyataan A masuk akal. Permen tidak asin, semangka tidak pahit, dan sup tidak manis.

Kunci Jawaban: **A (I'm drinking a very sour orange juice)**

options.label: A
options.content: I'm drinking a very sour orange juice

content: It is worn on the head to protect us from the sun. It is a ….
explanation:
Benda yang dipakai di kepala untuk melindungi dari sinar matahari adalah topi (*hat*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Hat)**

content: The choir group … from Jakarta.
explanation:
*The choir group* (paduan suara) dianggap satu kelompok (tunggal) dan menyatakan fakta sekarang, jadi memakai *is*.

Kunci Jawaban: **A (Is)**

content: Grandpa … some noodles last night.
explanation:
*Last night* menunjukkan masa lampau, jadi kata kerjanya bentuk kedua: *eat* → *ate*.

Kunci Jawaban: **D (Ate)**

content: Father … some vegetables from the garden and put them in the basket.
explanation:
Mengambil sayuran dari kebun disebut memetik (*picks*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Picks)**

content: My mother … the car with my brother yesterday.
explanation:
*Yesterday* menunjukkan masa lampau, jadi kata kerjanya *washed* (*wash* + *-ed*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Washed)**

content: Look at the picture. There is a beautiful … in the living room.
explanation:
Benda indah bergambar pemandangan yang digantung di dinding adalah lukisan (*painting*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Painting)**

content: Look at the picture. There is a … in the bedroom.
explanation:
Tempat menaruh buku-buku adalah rak buku (*bookshelf*).

Kunci Jawaban: **D (Bookshelf)**

content: Look at the picture. There is a … in the living room.
explanation:
Kursi panjang yang empuk di ruang keluarga untuk duduk menonton TV adalah sofa (*couch*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Couch)**

content:
Tio : What is this?
Sari : This flat, soft item lies on the floor and keeps our feet warm. This is a ….
explanation:
Benda datar dan lembut yang diletakkan di lantai untuk menghangatkan kaki adalah karpet kecil (*rug*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Rug)**

content:
Wira : Where is my notebook?
Lala : Your notebook is on the ….
explanation:
Wira duduk di sofa saat menonton TV, jadi bukunya ada di sofa (*couch*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Couch)**

content: Look at the picture! My mother drinks … in the morning.
explanation:
Minuman panas berwarna hitam dan pahit yang dibuat dari biji kopi adalah kopi (*a cup of coffee*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B (A cup of coffee)**

content: “He keeps his room organized and clean” from the statement, it means his room is ….
explanation:
*Organized and clean* (teratur dan bersih) artinya rapi (*tidy*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Tidy)**

content: Look at the pictures. There are several items in the kitchen, except …
explanation:
Mangkuk, kompor, dan wajan ada di dapur. Bantal (*pillow*, gambar B) ada di kamar tidur.

Kunci Jawaban: **B**

content: “I bought a new backpack for school, it's colorful and I like it.” Look at the pictures. Which one is the backpack?
explanation:
Ransel (*backpack*) adalah tas dengan dua tali untuk dibawa di punggung, yaitu gambar A. B tas selempang, C tas tangan, D dompet.

Kunci Jawaban: **A**

content:
:::passage[Dialog Soal: Buying Mangoes]
**Sari :** “Mom, I want to buy some mangoes.”
**Mom :** “We have some bananas in the fridge, Sari.”
**Sari :** “I don't want that, Mom, I like mangoes.”
**Mom :** “Okay, let's go to the market and buy some.”
**Sari :** “Alright, Mom.”
:::

Which is the correct sentence based on the conversation above?
explanation:
Sari ingin membeli mangga, dan ibunya berkata *"let's go to the market and buy some."* Jadi Sari dan ibunya ke pasar membeli mangga.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Sari and her mother go to the market to buy some mangoes)**

options.label: B
options.content: Sari goes to the market alone

options.content: Sari and her mother stay home and eat bananas

content:

content:

content: Rian eats too much candy so he has a ….
explanation:
Terlalu banyak makan permen bisa merusak gigi sehingga sakit gigi (*toothache*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Toothache)**

content: Which of the following statements is correct?
explanation:
Jeruk nipis rasanya asam, jadi *sour lime juice* benar. Permen tidak asin, mangga tidak pedas, jus jeruk tidak pahit.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Eka is drinking a sour lime juice)**

content: Look at the picture! What is it? It is a/an ….
explanation:
Buah bulat berkulit jingga yang manis-asam dan bisa dibuat jus adalah jeruk (*orange*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Orange)**

content: It is a small red fruit with tiny seeds on the outside and green leaves on top. It is a/an ….
explanation:
Buah kecil merah dengan biji-biji kecil di luar kulitnya dan daun hijau di atasnya adalah stroberi (*strawberry*).

content:
:::passage[Dialog (Soal No. 33 – 34)]
*The following dialog is for question number 33 and 34:*

**Bella :** “Hi Kevin, what are you eating?”
**Kevin :** “A few slices of watermelon. My mom prepared them in my lunch box.”
**Bella :** “Do you like watermelon?”
**Kevin :** “Yes, I love it, it's so juicy and sweet, especially on a hot day.”
:::

What does Kevin have in his lunch box?
explanation:
Kevin berkata: *"A few slices of watermelon. My mom prepared them in my lunch box."*

Kunci Jawaban: **A (Some watermelon slices)**

:::passage[Teks Bacaan (Soal No. 38 – 39)]
*The following text is for question number 38 and 39:*

Hello, my name is Salsa Amelia. I live in Malang, East Java. I am the youngest in my family. My oldest sister is Vania Amelia. She is 15 years old and studies in SMP Nusantara. My older brother is Rafi Amelia. He is 11 years old. He studies in SD Nusantara. I am the only one who is still in kindergarten.
:::

How many children does the Amelia family have?
explanation:
Keluarga Amelia punya tiga anak: Vania (perempuan), Rafi (laki-laki), dan Salsa (perempuan). Jadi dua perempuan dan satu laki-laki.

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Three children, two girls and one boy)**

options.label: A
options.content: Three children, all of them are girls

options.label: B
options.content: Three children, two girls and one boy

options.label: C
options.content: Three children, two boys and one girl

*The following text is for question number 38 and 39:*

Hello, my name is Salsa Amelia. I live in Malang, East Java. I am the youngest in my family. My oldest sister is Vania Amelia. She is 15 years old and studies in SMP Nusantara. My older brother is Rafi Amelia. He is 11 years old. He studies in SD Nusantara. I am the only one who is still in kindergarten.
:::

How old is most probably Salsa?
explanation:
Salsa anak bungsu dan masih TK (*kindergarten*), jadi umurnya paling mungkin 5 tahun.

Kunci Jawaban: **D (5 years old)**

content: What do I call my father's mother?
